description: This file defines the Vtiger_Role class, which manages role data within the vtiger CRM, including role hierarchy, retrieval, and deletion operations.

classes.name: Vtiger_Role
classes.description: Class representing roles in the vtiger CRM, providing methods for role hierarchy management, retrieval, and deletion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor to initialize a role object with id, name, parent role, and depth.

methods.name: getParentRole
methods.description: Returns the parent role sequence string.

methods.name: getDepth
methods.description: Returns the role's depth in the hierarchy.

methods.name: setDepty
methods.description: Sets the depth of the role.

methods.name: getInstanceByResult
methods.description: Creates a role instance from a database result row.

methods.name: getInstanceById
methods.description: Retrieves a role instance from the database by role ID.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the current role to a new parent role, updating hierarchy values.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the role and related associations from the database, and updates subordinate roles.
